import copy
import unittest
import notes

class UpdateNoteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.original = copy.deepcopy(notes.NOTES)

    def tearDown(self):
        notes.NOTES.clear()
        notes.NOTES.update(self.original)

    def test_owner_update_returns_detached_note(self):
        result = notes.update_note(7, 1, 'updated')
        self.assertEqual(result, {'owner': 7, 'text': 'updated'})
        self.assertEqual(notes.NOTES[1], result)
        self.assertEqual(notes.NOTES[2], self.original[2])
        result['text'] = 'external change'
        self.assertEqual(notes.NOTES[1]['text'], 'updated')

    def test_rejections_match_read_and_preserve_storage(self):
        for user_id, note_id in [(None, 1), (8, 1), (7, 999), (None, 999)]:
            with self.subTest(user_id=user_id, note_id=note_id):
                try:
                    notes.read_note(user_id, note_id)
                except (PermissionError, KeyError) as error:
                    expected_type, expected_args = type(error), error.args
                else:
                    self.fail('Expected read rejection')
                with self.assertRaises(expected_type) as caught:
                    notes.update_note(user_id, note_id, 'rejected')
                self.assertEqual(caught.exception.args, expected_args)
                self.assertEqual(notes.NOTES, self.original)

unittest.main()

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from links import with_query
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit

params = {'space key': 'two words', '유니코드': 'café 한글', 'a&b': 'x=y&z', 'last': ''}
result = with_query('https://example.com/path?old=a%20b&raw=x=y#part?x&y', params)
assert result.startswith('https://example.com/path?old=a%20b&raw=x=y&space+key=two+words&')
assert result.endswith('#part?x&y')
assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(result).query, keep_blank_values=True) == [('old', 'a b'), ('raw', 'x=y')] + list(params.items())
assert with_query('/path', {'q': 'a&b=c'}) == '/path?q=a%26b%3Dc'
assert with_query('/path#frag?x', {'q': 'a b'}) == '/path?q=a+b#frag?x'
assert with_query('/path?', {'q': 'x'}) == '/path?q=x'
assert with_query('/path?old=1&', {'q': 'x'}) == '/path?old=1&q=x'
assert with_query('/path#', {'q': 'x'}) == '/path?q=x#'
assert with_query('/path?raw=%2f+%20#fragment', {}) == '/path?raw=%2f+%20#fragment'
assert with_query('/path', {'z': 1, 'a': 2}) == '/path?z=1&a=2'
print('Passed encoding round-trip and 9 URL/order/preservation checks.')
